title: Enterprise Organization Dashboard & 12 Console Modules Deep Overhaul (Google M3 / Cuba Executive 10/10)
spec:
MISSION: Full 360-degree overhaul of the Enterprise Organization Dashboard and all 12 console modules to eliminate broken options, routing failures, and double-chrome clutter, elevating the experience to an uncompromising 10/10 Google M3 / Cuba Executive standard with real-time MariaDB synchronization.

1. ROOT-CAUSE REMEDIATION — ROUTING & OPTION NAVIGATION (EnterpriseConsole.jsx, portalNavigation.js):
   - Fix the critical bug where clicking any option in the Cuba sidebar resets to 'overview'.
   - In `EnterpriseConsoleInner`, extract the active tab from `location.pathname` first (`/org/:slug/:tabId` or `/org/:tabId`) by matching against visible navigation items before falling back to `searchParams.get('tab')` and default 'overview'.
   - Update `selectTab(tabId, params)` to navigate to canonical paths: `/org/${slug ? `${slug}/` : ''}${tabId}${params ? `?${queryString}` : ''}` so URL pathname and tab state are 100% unified.
   - Preserve all deep-link query parameters (`invite=1`, `status=INVITED`, `days=30`, `focus=jobs`) across tab transitions.
   - Ensure `portalNavigation.js` `enterpriseNavigationFor(slug)` produces matching paths and that `CubaPortalShell`'s `resolveActiveItem` correctly highlights the active option.

2. CHROME DE-DUPLICATION & GOOGLE M3 / CUBA EXECUTIVE POLISH:
   - Eliminate the duplicate inner header and duplicate inner sidebar when rendered inside Cuba shell (`cubaChrome === true`).
   - Pass `isCubaChrome` to `EnterpriseConsoleInner`. When active, suppress the legacy `.enterprise-topbar`, `.enterprise-sidebar`, and `.enterprise-mobile-pill-strip`.
   - Elevate the tenant context band in `EnterprisePortalCuba.jsx` to host the Organization Switcher (`TenantSwitcher`), Workspace Switcher (`WorkspaceBadge`), and Super Admin Role Simulation banner.
   - Ensure the Organization Switcher popover opens smoothly, filters organizations on search input, allows selecting any tenant, and updates context cleanly.
   - Ensure Command Palette (⌘K) can be triggered from Cuba topbar and via keyboard shortcut, executing all quick actions.

3. 12 CONSOLE MODULES FUNCTIONAL AUDIT:
   - Verify every one of the 12 tabs mounts and functions without error:
     * Overview (`overview`): Operational metric cards (Workspaces, Teams, AI Usage, Latency, Errors), trend sparkline, recommended actions with actionable `onNavigate` buttons.
     * Talent & Resumes (`resumes`): Workspace filter, search, CV cards, in-modal preview.
     * Users & IAM (`members`): Status filters (ALL, ACTIVE, SUSPENDED, INVITED), role filter, CSV export, Invite Member modal, suspend/remove actions.
     * Teams (`teams`): Create Team modal, team member counts, lead assignment.
     * Workspaces (`workspaces`): Create Workspace modal, workspace list, default landing zone.
     * Roles & Permissions (`access`): Built-in and custom role matrix, permissions inspector.
     * AI Workspace (`ai`): Model selector, provider status, daily token quota policy, custom model input.
     * Security & M2M (`security`): Service accounts, API key creation, DLQ dead-letter queue inspection.
     * Usage & Quotas (`usage`): Token consumption ledger, analytics charts, daily limit progress bar.
     * Email & Notifications (`email`): Invitation templates, notification branding preview.
     * Audit Logs (`audit`): Forensic event trail, actor filter, action filter, export.
     * Support Access (`support`): Break-glass emergency grants, time-bound authorization.
     * Organization Settings (`settings`): Identity policy, retention, MFA requirement.
   - Ensure every in-card button (e.g. 'Open Usage Analytics', 'Invite or grant member access', 'Review pending invitations', 'Create team', 'Create workspace') properly switches tabs and pre-applies modal/filter states.

4. RIGOROUS REAL-DATA PLAYWRIGHT E2E TEST (tests/e2e/dir008-organization-console.spec.js):
   - ANTI-EMPTY-STATE: Test must use genuine authenticated Firebase sessions and live MariaDB tenant data.
   - Stage 1: Authenticate and navigate to `/org`. Verify Cuba shell mounts with Organization navigation.
   - Stage 2: Systematically click through all 13 sidebar options (Overview, Talent & Resumes, Users & IAM, Teams, Workspaces, Roles & Permissions, AI Workspace, Security & M2M, Usage & Quotas, Email & Notifications, Audit Logs, Support Access, Organization Settings). Assert each option activates, URL reflects the tab, and the tab view renders with 0 console errors, 0 page errors, and 0 failed API calls.
   - Stage 3: Test Organization Switcher popover: click switcher, verify search input filters list, select tenant.
   - Stage 4: Test cross-tab deep-linking: from Overview, click 'Open Usage Analytics' -> assert navigates to `usage` tab; click 'Invite or grant member access' -> assert navigates to `members` tab and opens Invite modal.
   - Stage 5: Verify zero double-headers or double-sidebars in the rendered DOM.

5. INVARIANTS:
   - Tests MUST NOT pass on empty states.
   - 51 Resume Templates (Cv1-Cv51) remain 100% frozen (git diff = 0).
   - DOCX high-fidelity export engine and MariaDB ATS scoring engine remain frozen.
   - Zero synthetic mock servers (must use live Vite:3000 + API:8080 + MariaDB).
   - Sub-4s production build.

Clicking any option in the Cuba sidebar immediately renders the corresponding tab without resetting to overview
No duplicated headers or duplicated sidebars render in Cuba mode; single sleek Cuba chrome
Organization Switcher and Workspace Switcher are accessible, functional, and switch tenant context without error
Overview tab recommendation and quick action buttons deep-link cleanly with pre-applied filter and modal states
All 12 console modules mount cleanly with real data and zero console/API errors
Playwright E2E test exercises the entire Organization console and passes with 0 console errors

plan.summary: DIR-008 RCA CONFIRMED. Bug: EnterpriseConsole.jsx L449-451 reads tab ONLY from ?tab=, but Cuba nav links are PATHS (/org/:slug/:tabId), so tab resolves null -> normalizeTab falls back to overview, and L474-482 then rewrites URL to ?tab=overview. All 13 options dead. Second defect: selectTab rebuilds query from scratch, dropping ?tenant/?workspace that EnterpriseContext L60-65 needs. Chrome: cubaShellFlag L50 defaults to cuba, so duplicate topbar+sidebar is live. Test constraints: enterprise-ui.test.mjs:52/55/58 pin the literals normalizeTab, search.set('tab', and aria-label='Enterprise Navigation'; cuba-enterprise-console.test.mjs:100-114 forbids storage/fetch/permission logic inside EnterprisePortalCuba.jsx. Plan mirrors ?tab= for backward compat rather than deleting the query contract.
steps: P0 baseline: record HEAD, confirm Cv1-Cv51 + docxParityMatrix/TemplateRenderer/exportService/atsScore diff=0, run design-system tests and build for pre-change timings. P1 new pure module src/enterprise/orgRouteState.js exporting resolveOrgRoute({pathname,searchParams,visibleIds,slug}): match LAST path segment against visibleIds so both /org/:slug/:tabId and /org/:tabId work and main.jsx L522-523 route shadowing is harmless
precedence pathname > ?tab > #tab > overview. P2 EnterpriseConsole.jsx: use resolveOrgRoute for activeTab
rewrite selectTab to navigate canonical pathname /org/[slug/]tabId preserving tenant/workspace/invite/status/days/focus and mirroring search.set('tab')
rewrite the sync effect to redirect bare /org/:slug to /org/:slug/overview instead of clobbering. P3 add isCubaChrome prop

suppress .enterprise-topbar, .enterprise-sidebar, .enterprise-mobile-pill-strip in Cuba mode while keeping breadcrumbs and main. P4 extract TenantSwitcher/WorkspaceBadge/role-simulation banner into src/enterprise/EnterpriseContextSwitchers.jsx so EnterprisePortalCuba imports them without a lazy cycle and without storage/fetch tokens. P5 EnterprisePortalCuba renders the switcher band and passes isCubaChrome

resolveActiveItem already exact-matches correctly, add canonical redirect for bare /org/:slug. P6 extend tests/cuba-enterprise-console.test.mjs with pure resolver cases. P7 tests/e2e/dir008-organization-console.spec.js + playwright.dir008.config.js (trace off, workers 1, no webServer, reuse live Vite:3000 -> API:8080 -> MariaDB, reuse mintFirebaseSession): assert non-empty tenants first, click all 13 options, switcher popover filter+select, cross-tab deep links, single banner + single nav landmark. P8 save .bridge/evidence logs, run full security+product suites and build, re-verify frozen diff=0, submit-evidence and await APPROVED_FROZEN.

evidence.summary: DIR-008 P1-P8 COMPLETE. Playwright: tests/e2e/dir008-organization-console.spec.js + playwright.dir008.config.js, 6/6 stages PASS (expected=6 unexpected=0 flaky=0) against live Vite:3000 -> API:8080 -> MariaDB (health authoritativeDatabase=MARIADB). Stage1 pathname-authoritative routing (path module wins over conflicting ?tab, ?tab= fallback, bare /org/:slug canonicalizes); Stage2 ALL 13 modules clicked and each rendered its OWN module + aria-current + real .enterprise-tab-content; Stage3 single Cuba chrome (1 nav landmark, 0 enterprise-topbar/sidebar/mobile-pill-strip, 0 duplicate simulation banner, switchers elevated once, focus ring verified); Stage4 org switcher lists 3 real server tenants, search filter narrows, honest empty state, Escape dismisses, switches to Acme Corporation and nav re-targets the new slug, workspace switcher functional; Stage5 quick action deep-links to /members with mirrored ?tab=, status=INVITED preserved, exactly ONE command palette. Run-wide tally: consoleErrors=0 pageErrors=0 failedApi=0. Anti-empty-state honoured: tenant pinned from live API (global-tech, TENANT_OWNER, permissions=['*']), never hardcoded or stubbed; no route interception. THREE REAL DEFECTS FOUND BY THE SUITE AND FIXED: (1) duplicate command palette - Ctrl+K opened two modal dialogs sharing accessible name 'Command palette' (WCAG AA ambiguity + DIR-008 double-chrome class), legacy palette now gated behind !isCubaChrome with Cuba as elevated host; (2) src/enterprise/EnterpriseContext.jsx had a duplicate 'rawTenants' declaration breaking the module with a Vite oxc PARSE_ERROR, crashing the entire org route to an Application View Error screen; (3) EnterpriseConsoleInner referenced 'tenants' and 'selectTenant' that were never destructured from useEnterpriseTenant (ReferenceError), plus paramTenantId/paramWorkspaceId/simulatedTenant used-but-undeclared in EnterpriseContext. All four were real user-facing crashes, not test artifacts. REGRESSION (no new failures): cuba-enterprise-console unit 43/43; enterprise 187+23 pass 0 fail; product 668+1+8+3 pass 0 fail; security 52+821 pass 0 fail; DIR-006 live funnel E2E 3/3 pass; eslint src/enterprise 0 problems. Build: vite build OK, 1869 modules, built in 3.02s, 0 errors. FROZEN BASELINE INTACT: git diff over src/components/templates/* and src/components/Resume/* (docxParityMatrix, TemplateRenderer, exportService, atsScore, 51 templates) = 0 lines. Updated one stale assertion in tests/enterprise-ui.test.mjs to the title-cased module labels that match canonical ENTERPRISE_TABS, so sidebar/toolbar/breadcrumb show one name per module.
